id.description: Question number, 1-based, exactly as numbered in <task>.

status.description: on_topic: answered, with a reason, detail or example. partial: touched on but not really answered. minimal: answered in one bare sentence with no reason, detail or example. missing: not addressed. off_topic: talks about something else.

evidence.description: Exact substring of the transcript where the student answers this question, or an empty string.

note.description: One short sentence about what the student said for this question.

model_answer.description: For partial, minimal, missing or off_topic: one or two short sentences (at most 30 words) the student could say, one level above their language level. Keep any view they gave; if they gave none, a frame with both options (should / shouldn't … because …). Empty string for on_topic.

level.description: Best fit against the official descriptors: above_B2, B2, B1 or below_B1.

evidence.description: Exact substrings copied from the transcript (the student's own words, mistakes included). Never paraphrase.

note.description: One short sentence for the student: why this level, referring to the quotes.

how_to_improve.description: One concrete instruction for the next attempt that would move this feature towards the next level. Name the words or structure.

how_to_check.description: How the student can tell, after the next attempt, that they did it.

memorized_or_irrelevant.description: true only if the whole answer is clearly a memorised/prepared text that ignores the questions, or is irrelevant to the task.

quote.description: Exact substring of the transcript containing the error.

correction.description: The same words, corrected. Keep the student's meaning.

pattern.description: The name of the error pattern in error_patterns this error belongs to (copied exactly), or an empty string for a one-off error.

errors.description: The most important grammar and vocabulary errors, most serious first.

name.description: Short name of a repeated error type, e.g. 'Missing -s after he/she/it'.

rule.description: One sentence explaining the rule, with a short correct example.

how_to_fix.description: One concrete habit for the next attempt that prevents this error.

error_patterns.description: 0-4 error types that occur more than once (or one important type), most important first. Each must be used by at least one entry in errors.

quote.description: Exact substring of the transcript that shows B2-or-better language for this feature.

note.description: One short sentence: what is good about it.

strengths.description: 0-2 strengths. Only for a feature you judged B2 or above_B2, each with an exact quote. Empty if there is none.

summary.description: Honest comparison with the previous attempt. Never invent improvement.
